unsupported.reason: five-kernel chain (Layernorm2dFwd + rope cache store + 2x hadamard + act_quant + indexer_k_quant_and_cache) at m<=42 rows. TraceLens has no model for the chain, and at this size the seam is dominated by the ~2.3 us per-node in-graph dispatch floor rather than by its bytes -- a byte roofline would be a confident number about the wrong quantity. Use the rocprof leg (per-kernel) for this one.
